formulaBlock.normalization: Aqua/Water/Eau one entry; positions = packet order (normalized, one-based).

cleansingStrength.rationale: Low (C6): no strong anionic; earliest prominent cleansing surfactant is the mild anionic Sodium Methyl Cocoyl Taurate (2) with prominent co-surfactants Decyl Glucoside (3), Cocamidopropyl Betaine (4) and Coco-Glucoside (8).
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Taurate is an effective mild anionic; Disodium Tetrapropenyl Succinate (13) adds a minor anionic. Neither is a strong anionic.

conditioningLevel.rationale: High via W-RICH (Section 5 anchor): prominent payload lipids Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil (6) and Hydrogenated Castor Oil (11) converge with Amodimethicone (9) and Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (10), plus pearlizing Glycol Distearate (14). C2 itself is not met because no listed humectant is present (Hexylene Glycol does not count, R11).
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Missing deliberate humectant route (C2 R11); oils and silicone sit after salt (5), so levels are modest (neighbor moderate).

weightPotential.rationale: High (W-RICH plus limited reset): prominent argan oil (6) and waxy Hydrogenated Castor Oil (11) converge with an amino-silicone (9) and cationic guar (10) in a mild C6 taurate/glucoside chassis whose reset capacity is weak.

depositionLoad.rationale: Four converging deposition routes (payload_lipid x2, silicone, cationic_polymer) all prominent, plus a coconut-acid refatter.

persistence.rationale: Amodimethicone is substantive and HCO is waxy; liquid argan oil less retained.

resetCapacity.rationale: C6 mild taurate/glucoside/betaine system with no strong anionic.

weak_refatter.note: fatty acid, likely taurate raw-material carry-over

unresolved.reason: modified anionic starch; emulsion-stabilizing/film-forming role not resolvable from INCI; could only add deposition (toward high), so it cannot move the band lighter

weightPotential.whyThisBand: W-RICH is established by formula evidence and resetCapacity is weak, which is the high anchor's rich route.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate: the moderate reading needs reset or limited richness to argue against coating; here richness is formula-established and the mild C6 chassis does not offset it.
weightPotential.limitingFactor: All deposition sits after salt (5) so levels are modest; liquid argan oil persistence is moderate (neighbor moderate).

focusPrimary.rationale: Pending claims. Care-direction verdict provisional: repair_supported (oil, waxy lipid, amodimethicone, guar deposition cluster); no humectant cluster for moisture.

usageRole.rationale: Default; frequent possible with explicit frequency wording (cleansing low).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: No positioning yet. CSA formula half met via prominent payload lipids (6, 11) on the E4 humectant/refatting list; no comfort route.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole in the complete INCI.

unresolvedMaterialIngredients.reason: weight-relevant function unresolved; direction of any effect is toward more deposition, so it does not undermine the high band but keeps confidence at moderate

uncertainties: conditioningLevel high via the W-RICH anchor although C2 fails on the humectant element; alternative reading moderate (C2 R11 sentence).
